description: This file contains functions for searching and building a 9-bit algebraic codebook with 2 pulses in a 40-sample frame, used in AMR speech codec. It includes code for pulse position search, codeword construction, and related utilities.

methods.name: code_2i40_9bits
methods.description: Searches a 9-bit algebraic codebook with 2 pulses in a 40-sample frame, returning the code index and generating the codeword, filtered code, and pulse signs.

methods.name: search_2i40
methods.description: Finds the best positions for 2 pulses in the codebook based on correlation matrices.

methods.name: Test_search_2i40
methods.description: External interface to search_2i40, used for testing.

methods.name: build_code
methods.description: Constructs the algebraic codeword, filtered code, and pulse signs based on pulse positions and signs.

methods.name: Test_build_code
methods.description: External interface to build_code, used for testing.
